name: Thraisai
description: Thraisai was a planet located in the Thraisai system of Wild Space. At some point between 17 BBY and 0 ABY, the Human bounty hunter Beilert Valance led a group of mercenaries in capturing a ring of enslavers on Thraisai, a mission that helped Valance attain the status of an elite hunter.
